_readme: universe.theme.json — the 3D universe deck's per-instance theme (core-v0.4 S4).
Seeded to .kickoff/universe.theme.json at adopt time; THAT copy is yours to edit
(it is never regenerated or drift-pinned — edit, save, reload /universe).
WHAT YOU CAN TUNE — palette (retint) + bounded knobs (rescale) + strings:
palette.*      strict '#rrggbb' colors. An invalid value falls back to the default.
knobs.*        multipliers on the shipped look (1.0 = default). Each is CLAMPED to
bounds in the deck:  particleDensity 0.25–2.0 · bloomStrength 0–1.8
· starSize 0.6–1.6 · galaxySize 0.7–1.3 · tunnelIntensity 0.3–1.6.
strings.*      signature (enter-screen credit line, empty = hidden), tagline (the
enter-screen sub-line), genesisLabel (what the readout calls the
center when you fly into it — the org's genesis / control plane).
WHAT IS FIXED — the organic primitives are NOT themeable, by design: soft additive
round-point stars, the offset-blob nebula clouds, halos-not-rings, curved quantum
tunnels. A theme retints and rescales the cosmos; it cannot turn it into hard
geometric shapes. The defaults below ARE the shipped organic look.
PALETTE MAP: accent = in-progress/core (the hero teal) · accentWarm = waiting/labels
· accentPlan = needs-planning · ambient = ambient particles · idle = idle functions
· bg1/bg2 = panel backgrounds · space = the void (page bg + depth fog) · galaxyHues =
cycled per-domain galaxy tints (1–12 entries) · galaxyCore = the warm galaxy-core /
star-birth light · galaxyEdge = the deep dust edge · coreHalo/coreGlow/coreHeart =
the central genesis glow, outer→inner · jarvis/jarvisDim = the command-layer readout.
